basis: Automatic reorder creates a purchase request when an item's projected stock falls to its reorder level (requirement req_stk_reorder); restocking is the warehouse word for that purchase-driven refill. Internal pick-location replenishment by stock transfer is a different activity and is not covered by this entry.
Stock count is the periodic count of physical stock against the system (requirement req_stk_count). Its glossary already lists 'stocktake' and 'cycle count' as other names for a stock count.
Sales return records items a customer returns against the delivery note (requirement req_whs_return); 'customer return' is the same activity named from the customer's side.

Receive goods and put away registers incoming goods on a receipt and assigns them to a warehouse (requirements req_whs_receive, req_whs_putaway); receiving is the warehouse's own word for the first half.
Pick and deliver an order creates the pick list for a sales order, picks it and delivers it (requirements req_whs_pick, req_whs_deliver); order picking is the same first half of that process.
